leads.name: Bodnant Garden champion trees

location.address: Bodnant Garden, Tal-y-Cafn, Conwy LL28 5RE (NT, paid)

leads.reason: Walk-through garden; Tree Register champions (about 40 UK and 130 Wales per a search summary, not a fetched page). The named Wales Champion 51 m coast redwood was uprooted in Storm Arwen (Nov 2021, North Wales Pioneer article quoting National Trust): dead, never ship. A 35 m giant sequoia planted 1890 is cited only by a Countryfile summary; no pin or second source. Needs a Tree Register or NT page naming a surviving individual tree.

leads.name: Llanrwst churchyard yew (St Grwst)
leads.reason: AYG lists one notable yew 396 cm at 90 cm; not remarkable enough.

leads.name: Llanfair Talhaiarn yew (St Mary)
leads.reason: AYG notable yew 395 cm at 130 cm; poet Talhaiarn is buried beneath the 'grand old yew' (1872 engraving). Modest girth, no pin.

leads.name: Capel Garmon yews
leads.reason: Only on AYG's younger-yews list (some near 12 ft girth): not remarkable.

leads.name: Mamhilad yews (St Illtyd)
leads.reason: AYG: 1799 Coxe recorded 12 yews; 1873 report of a 29 ft 4 in girth yew; a site with a lost yew (visited 2014). Worth a pass for current girths from the 2025 site file (Mamhilad-2025.pdf), not fetched.

leads.name: Llanfaredd yew (St Mary)
leads.reason: AYG ancient 7m+ tree 96, 922 cm at 60 cm (1998), west of church; only AYG plus a Geograph photo (Bill Nicholls, CC BY-SA 2.0, geograph 3710020), no second source or life check (lifecheck NONE).

notes: 2026-11-03 Welsh yews and Snowdonia pass. Delivered six in wales-yews-verified.json. Not reached: Strata Florida, Llanfihangel-nant-Melan, Bettws Newydd, Corwen, Overton-on-Dee, Plas Newydd, Gwydir Uchaf. ancient-yew.org/yew_tree_database/<slug>/ pages fetch fine with curl; the overton-on-dee slug 404s.
